Name: Fresh Fish Compatibility Patch
Author: KimchiTea
Description:
Makes the following edits to Fresh Fish maps:

- moved Bonito Bonanza sign to avoid overlapping Elliott's mailbox from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6427]Ayeisha the Postal Worker[/url]
- moved Bonito Bonanza tent to avoid overlapping [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34865]Nagito Komaeda's house[/url]
- moved Two Shoe Tony down in non-SVE installs so he's not overlapping Kaelen from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51711]Rupnan's Collection Remake[/url]

If I've put them in the way of other mods, let me know with screenshots and I'll see if I can find a better location.

To install, extract to your mod folder where Fresh Fish is installed and overwrite the existing files.

Released with permission from Luminte.
